## 🎯 Objective  
Implement configuration management system using `.properties` file to externalize browser settings and test configurations.

---

## 📋 Tasks  
- [ ] Create `config.properties` file with browser and test configurations  
- [ ] Implement `Configuration.java` class to read properties  
- [ ] Update `TextBoxTest.java` to use configuration instead of hardcoded values  
- [ ] Verify configuration works in both headless and headed modes  
- [ ] Test cross-browser compatibility (Chrome/Firefox)

---

## 🔧 Technical Details  
**Configuration File:**  
`src/test/resources/config.properties`  
```properties
# Browser Configuration
browser=chrome
headless=true
base.url=https://demoqa.com
```
---
### Configuration Class:
**src/test/java/config/Configuration.java**
- Simple properties reader with static methods
- Support for browser type, headless mode, and base URL

**Updated Test:**
src/test/java/tests/TextBoxTest.java
- Use Configuration.getBrowser() and Configuration.isHeadless()
- Use Configuration.getBaseUrl() for dynamic URL handling
---
## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- Properties file loads successfully
- Configuration class provides access to all properties
- Test runs successfully using configured values
- Headless mode works in CI environment
- Browser type can be changed via configuration
---
## 🔗 Dependencies
- Requires Selenium WebDriver setup (v0.1.0)
- Compatible with existing test framework structure

## 📝 Notes
- Keep configuration simple and minimal
- Maintain backward compatibility with existing tests
- Ensure easy configuration switching for different environments
